description:
The generator of the dense-parity source-evidence ledger reads the working tree and overwrites a receipt-pinned ledger when run; a pinned record is not rewritten by its own tool.

## Background

`dev/active/2037941f-profile-and-optimize-mid-range-buffer-operations/survey/make-dense-parity-source-evidence.py` writes `survey/dense-parity-source-evidence.json` from whatever tree it runs in. The ledger is a producing input pinned by the dense-parity receipts and cited by the frozen dense-parity addendum, and it is verified as a record of its recorded commits by `dev/scripts/verify-source-evidence.py`. Running the generator on a later tree replaces the pinned bytes with rows for that tree. The revision the ledger records reproduces every row's commit and digest fields.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Running the generator on any tree leaves the committed ledger byte-identical or refuses to write, shown by a test that runs it on a tree where cited lines have moved.
- [hard] REQ-02: The generator reproduces the committed ledger from the content of the revision the ledger records, and a check mode reports a mismatch without writing.
- [hard] REQ-03: No committed receipt, receipt input snapshot, trial ledger or frozen addendum changes, and the dense producing-input closure check passes.

## Notes

Found while making the ledger verifiable. The generator is itself an enumerated producing input of the dense campaigns; committed receipts keep their own snapshot of it.
title: Stop the dense-parity source-evidence generator rewriting its pinned ledger
